newsitem.title: USA: Investor says takes 16 pct Harmony Holdings stake.
newsitem.headline: Investor says takes 16 pct Harmony Holdings stake.

text.p: Glenn Laken said Wednesday he registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission ownership of 1,056,712 shares of Harmony Holdings Inc.

Laken identified himself in a news release as a private investor representing himself, business associates and family members, in ownership of what amounts to about 16 percent of Harmony's shares outstanding.
Los Angeles-based Harmony produces television commercials, music videos, World Wide Web sites; and develops television programming and feature films.

"We acquired what we believe to be currently undervalued shares of Harmony for long-term investment purpose," Laken said in a statement. "We are pleased with the direction that management has taken the company over the past year. We believe in the company and its business plan and we expect to acquire more shares throughout the year," he said.
A Harmony spokeswoman said Laken has been in contact with the company and, "We are pleased to have him" as a shareholder.
Laken was not immediately available to provide more information.
Shares of Harmony closed off 7/16 to 2-15/16.
